commands.name: semantic gateway UT/DT
commands.command: python3.11 -m pip install '.[dev]' && PYTHONPATH=src python3.11 -m pytest -q tests --junitxml=$REPORT_DIR/pytest.xml

commands.name: CellMem pure UT/DT

commands.name: AgentLink UT/DT
